seed_ideas.title: Mapping AAV capsid-receptor interactions to explain barrier transcytosis versus intracellular retention
seed_ideas.text: Basically molecularly mapping the interaction between an agent (the ones we use in the lab) and surface receptors, to understand why certain variants can pass through a cell to the other side while others remain inside the cell. It is complex and requires a dataset that I'm not sure how to obtain. The gap is a matched dataset linking capsid-receptor binding signatures to transcytosis versus intracellular retention in brain microvascular endothelial cells.
seed_ideas.root_question: Can molecular mapping of AAV capsid-receptor interactions on brain microvascular endothelial cells determine which AAV variants transcytose across the blood-brain barrier versus remain intracellular, and for which capsid-receptor binding signatures?
